Bug_Title: RANGE: Array offset is out of bounds (RANGE_ARRAY_OFFSET)
Bug_Details: Method is called with array parameter and offset parameter, but the offset is out of bounds. This will result in IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The method showBug is called with an offset parameter that is greater than the last index of the array, leading to an IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBugWithOutOfBoundsOffset method calls the showBug method with an offset of 10 on an array of length 5, which is out of bounds, thus triggering an IndexOutOfBoundsException.
